title: Understanding Decision Thresholds
text: When you lower the decision threshold in a logistic regression model, you are essentially making it easier for the model to predict the positive class. Think about how this might affect the number of true positives and false positives.

title: Impact on ROC-AUC
text: The ROC-AUC is a measure of the model's ability to distinguish between classes. Consider whether changing the threshold affects the model's inherent ability to separate the classes, or if it just changes the point at which you decide to classify a prediction as positive.

hintAnswer: The number of false positives increases.
title: Effect of Lowering Threshold
text: What happens to the number of false positives when you lower the threshold from $$0.5$$ to $$0.3$$?
choices: The number of false positives increases.
The number of false positives decreases.
The number of false positives stays the same.
